_note: Treated config of TwoCompartmentWithNutrientFKPPSolver, the two-compartment model under a Stupp protocol (resection, radiotherapy, concomitant and adjuvant chemotherapy): the class default config fisher_kpp_jax/configs/TwoCompartmentWithNutrientFKPPSolver.json with the schedule block of fisher_kpp_jax/configs/FKPPSolver_stupp.json (resection_time, time_after_resection in place of stopping_time, chemo_times, chemo_doses, chemo_kill_rate, chemo_decay_rate, rt_times, rt_alpha, rt_alpha_beta_ratio, steps_per_day), written 2026-10-01. It is NOT the class default. It is read by path: the base config of scripts/patient_cmaes_fit.py with --solver twospecies (the patient scripts replace the volumes, the seed, the growth and treatment parameters, the schedule and the time step per run; what they take from here are the protocol doses, the response and structural entries and the four two-compartment parameters when the search space does not set them). The horizon is given as time_after_resection; stopping_time is left out (at most one of the two may be set). The physical parameters (white_matter_diffusivity, rho, the seed) are the class config's, not medians of a search space; the treatment response values are the ones of FKPPSolver_stupp.json (placeholders awaiting review, see its _treatment). Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; the tissue maps are the reference_solves/ maps (182x218x182, 1 mm); the seed is the image center.
_placeholders: necrosis_rate, nutrient_threshold, nutrient_diffusivity and nutrient_consumption_rate are PLACEHOLDERS (the values of tests/test_solvers.py), not fitted values. scripts/patient_cmaes_fit.py --solver twospecies fits all four (fisher_kpp_jax/search_spaces/sailor_patient_twospecies_fit_search_space.json).
_treatment: chemo_kill_rate (1/day per mg/m^2; 2.236e-3 is the geometric centre of the sensitivity search space's range 5e-4-1e-2, a total log kill kill * dose / decay of 2.15 over the full 8 900 mg/m^2 schedule at chemo_decay_rate 9.24, 1.19 over the sensitivity analysis's truncated 4 900 mg/m^2 schedule; the parametrisation has no literature source, the range is set by the bounds on the log kill, see the search space's _chemo), chemo_decay_rate (1/day; 9.24 is temozolomide's ~1.8 h plasma half-life, Baker et al. 1999, Clin Cancer Res 5:309) and rt_alpha (1/Gy; 0.04472 is the geometric centre of the search space's range 0.01-0.2) are PLACEHOLDERS awaiting review. rt_alpha_beta_ratio is the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio in Gy (rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio in 1/Gy^2 is derived by the solver and is not a config entry); 8 Gy is the midpoint of the search space's 4-12 Gy (the class default is 10 Gy).
